Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Engagement launch — intro + hands-on alignment (agenda + load trials)

Hi Daniel / Sophie,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We'd love to lock in an initial engagement-launch call to:
- introduce key stakeholders,
- align on success criteria and roles, and
- run a short hands-on block (prompt review + routing demo + a focused load walk-through).

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Jul 20, 10:00–11:30am
- Wed Jul 21, 1:00–2:30pm
- Thu Jul 22, 9:00–10:30am

Suggested agenda (60–90 min):
1) 15m — intros & goals (who owns what)
2) 20m — prompt set review and success criteria for quality
3) 25m — routing & KV-cache demo (how requests map to model variants)
4) 20m — lightweight load smoke test & expected metrics
5) 10m — next steps / mutual action plan

I attached a short agenda and a sample prompt set so your team can pick the items you want us to exercise during the hands-on block.

Attachments: redwood_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf (agenda + timing), sample_prompt_set.csv

If you confirm a slot, I will send a calendar invite with a short runbook for the load test (and add Ben Carter, our SE, and Monica Patel from CS).

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Naomi — thanks, this looks great.

We can do Tue Jul 20 but need the call to be 90 minutes to fit all technical folks. Proposed final attendees from our side:
- Sophie Tran (Head of ML)
- Rajiv Menon (Platform)
- Claire Huang (App Dev)

A few asks from our side:
- Wed like the hands-on to include a short routing exercise (how requests move between model variants) and one KV-cache validation.
- Can Redwood run a short routing smoke test during the session (20m) to observe latency under our small synthetic load? We expect to exercise ~120 concurrent RPS for a 5-minute window for the smoke run.
- Wed also prefer a security pre-call or separate thread so our security team (cc'ed on a follow-up) can confirm logging and retention for the trial.

Slots: Tue Jul 20 at 10:00 PT works if you can make it 90 minutes. Otherwise Wed 21 13:00 PT is fine.

Thanks — Daniel
Daniel Park
Director, ML Platforms | Helix Analytics
daniel.park@helixanalytics.com

Adding a few technical notes so were aligned heading into Tue: 
- For the prompt review: please flag 6–8 canonical prompts you care about (the sample_prompt_set.csv is perfect). Well evaluate quality across two model variants and capture sample outputs.
- Load smoke plan: Ill start at ~40 RPS warmup, ramp to 120 RPS for a 5-minute window, then step down. Ill collect p50/p95/p99 and 99.9 for the session.
- Routing demo: Ill show a live policy that routes by customer tier and request length; we can flip to a cheaper model for non-critical paths.

Attaching a one-page run checklist to the calendar invite (inline) and will post a short pre-run checklist in the Drive link before the call.
